decisionsTitle: Every email a staff press sends carries its press, «Emailuri azi» lists the day's emails, and the toast after the press says what it emailed
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-03** (his four choices, as the design «telling the owner about every email a staff press sends» records them): every staff press that sends an email should say so before the press, say after it what left and when, let him untick the person's email where that is sensible, and there should be one list of every email of the day. The design builds it in four slices on one backbone; this branch carries them, each slice adding its decisions here.

**Slice 1 — the backbone and the day's list.**

- **Every row says what queued it.** Two columns on `email_outbox`, expand only (migration `0189_email_press`): `cause`, a closed token of the press or the job (`notifications/domain/press-causes.ts`: `registrations.cancel`, `volunteers.assign`, `job.registrationMaintenance`, … with the main emails each press sends the person it acts on, for the toast of slice 2), and `press_id`, one id per press or job run shared by every row it queued — the person's message, the club's copies, an offer to the next in line. Neither holds personal data. `requested_by_staff_user_id` is now filled by every staff press (a requester the service names still wins); only the manual-resend history reads it, so nothing on screen changes.
- **The email press scope** (`notifications/press.ts`): every emailing Server Action of the design's list — 44 presses across registrations, events, volunteers and the club — wraps its whole body in `inEmailPress("<cause>", …)` and names its actor with `press.by(actor.id)` right after its staff check; the two job routes open the jobs' scopes, and so do the drains that do the outbox job's work after a response (Next's `after()` carries a request's async scopes into its callback, and a road's notice queued there is the job's, never the press's). `AsyncLocalStorage`, part of Node — no new dependency — rather than React's per-request `cache`, which the road choice already hedges may not hold in a Server Action. A public flow opens none: its rows read «de pe site». `enqueueEmail`, the club's copies (per message and per bulk send) and the relay stamp each row from the scope; the scope labels rows and never decides whether or when one leaves. Presses that queue nothing themselves open none: «Trimite acum», publishing (the job queues the alerts under its own scope), Zitadel's password link, the timing and road settings. `tests/unit/shared/emailing-presses.test.ts` holds every listed press to its scope and its actor, refuses a scope in an unlisted action or on a public flow; `tests/e2e/email-journal.spec.ts` runs one press, «Anulează înscrierea», through Next itself and reads the stamps back, and the press on «Emailuri azi».
- **One judgement of when a waiting email leaves** (`notifications/domain/departure.ts#departureOf`, moved from the queue panel): the queue, «Emailuri azi» and the toast of slice 2 ask it. Two things it says that the queue did not: «Pleacă după ce Mailgun reia: HH:MM (estimat).» for a Mailgun-road row while Mailgun is stopped and nothing carries it, or while a Free plan's day is spent; and «Pleacă acum» for a row the «imediat» timing's drain is still sending (queued a moment ago, never tried). The second is judged after the first: that drain's claim takes no Mailgun-road row while Mailgun is stopped and nothing carries it, and a spent Free day's refusal defers the row to the reset, so such a row says when Mailgun reopens, never «acum» — for up to five minutes the queue and the day's list would otherwise promise what waits for the reopening. A press's own «Trimite acum» (§540) stays «acum» even then: it is asked only with room to send. The late judgement is health's, unchanged.
- **«Emailuri azi»** (`/admin/settings/emails/today`, «Setări» → «Emailuri» stays marked): every email of the club's day — left since midnight on the club's clock, waiting from any day, failed or refused today — with the person's name and address, in two sections, «Așteaptă acum» then «Au plecat azi», one row per press with its moment, its cause in words and who pressed («automat: …» for a job, «De pe site» for a row no press queued). The name comes from the registration, the volunteer's row (the parent's on the parent's link) or the colleague's account found by its canonical address. The club's own mailboxes — a copy, the declaration's archive, «cineva a confirmat» — fold under the message they copy or under their press, by the audience map (Critic correction 4), never counted as people. More than five lines of one email in one press fold behind one line that says how many. Never the payload's words, a body, a link or a provider's detail beyond a failed row's sanitized reason; capped at 2000 rows with «Și încă N».
- **The "am I sending too much" signal** (Critic correction 5, which overrides the design's "three or more emails today"): three emails is the ordinary registration journey, so the warning at the top lists only **the same email to the same person twice or more today**, counted by the canonical address (AGENTS.md §10.4, never a raw compare) on the person's own mail — never the club's or a colleague's notices — and on real rows only. The design's count is kept as a quiet chip on each line of a person who got three or more emails today. Both count **only the rows that left** — sent, or refused by the person's server after it left — never one still waiting: three roles given in three presses queue three rows, held a few minutes after the last (§901), and the sending withdraws the two a later press made stale, so the person gets one email; counted while they wait, «Au primit același email de mai multe ori azi» would warn of what never arrives. A failed row reached nobody and counts for nobody. A test registration's row is marked «Test» and counted nowhere (AGENTS.md §12.6).
- **Who reads it:** the Administrator and the Superadministrator alone, asserted by the page on the server (`requireStaffCapability(canManageRegistrations)`, BR-REQ-060-01): it names people and addresses they already read on the list, in the exports and in the queue. The desk's roles, the Organizer and the Tehnic role are refused before a row is read; the links — the «Emailuri» tab, the queue panel's «Vezi ce a plecat azi», «Emailuri de trimis» on «Înscrieri» — are drawn only for the two roles.

**Slice 1: refused or left for later, and why.** The queue panel stays the reader of what waits for the club's verbs, and the page keeps «Așteaptă acum» as the build asked; the two share one judgement of each row's time (Critic correction 10 asked to fold the page into the panel instead). Zitadel's own emails are not in our queue and the page says so: listing them needs an audit row per Zitadel call in the staff presses (Critic correction 8), left for a later slice. A message withdrawn before it left is deleted to free its key and so is not listed; the page says that too. Saying a person's waiting rows apart in the warning («X au plecat, Y așteaptă») was left out: «Așteaptă acum» already lists them, by press. No other day (`?day=`) and no Organizer view.

**Slice 2 — the toast after the press says what it emailed.**

- **What the toast says.** After the act's own sentence, an emailing press's toast says what left — each email's type in the words of «Emailuri» —, to how many — the person the press acted on, the club's mailboxes, other people, test addresses counted apart — and when: «Înscrierea a fost anulată. Pleacă la 10:15 (estimat): „Înscriere anulată” către 1 persoană și 1 email pentru club. În plus, 1 email către altă persoană: „S-a eliberat un loc”.» The road the press's dialog chose (§841) is told inside the line («Pleacă acum prin Gmail-ul clubului: …»); outside an email press the bare «Pleacă prin …» stays as it was, and a press that queued nothing names no road.
- **Read from what the press really queued.** `flashOutcome` — the one call every emailing press's way back makes — and `withPressMail` (the participant message's and the import's own notice) read the press's rows back by `press_id` once its transaction committed (`notifications/press-receipt.ts`), so a row withdrawn inside the same press (the waiting-list email an offer replaced) is not told. The person's own email is a type the cause names as its main one (`press-causes.ts`); the club's side is a copy, the declaration's archive, «cineva a confirmat» and a notice to the club's people — a new order, a new volunteer (`email-audience.ts#isClubSide`, Critic correction 4: never «alte persoane»); the rest is other people; a test registration's row is counted apart and never among the people (AGENTS.md §12.6). The rows are read one by one rather than in the design's one aggregate query: each is judged by the queue's own `departureOf`, exactly, and a press's rows are the ones it inserted a moment before. A press that queued nothing costs one look by the press's index and adds nothing.
- **When — one judgement.** Each part's time is the queue panel's and «Emailuri azi»'s (`departureOf`, slice 1): now (a press's «Trimite acum», or the «imediat» timing's drain), at the estimated hour of the outbox job's run — a volunteer's roles email held two minutes for the next press included —, after Mailgun resumes while it is stopped and nothing carries the row, or over the next days for the part of a newsletter today's room past the reserve cannot hold (§445). A send split between two moments says both: «Pleacă acum: „Mesaj de la organizatori” către 40 de persoane; celelalte 5 pleacă la 10:30 (estimat).» (the participant message's «now» past what one press sends, §540, said until now by two sentences of its own). The context is read as the queue panel reads it, with the governor's floor taken from the level this instance last heard (`budget-level.ts`), never a request to Neon from inside a press. An hour, not «in N minutes»: it stays true when the toast is read a minute later, and it is the queue's own wording.
- **Nothing when nothing was queued.** The build asked it: a press that queued nothing says nothing about email — the design's «Nu a plecat niciun email.» was not built, since it would follow almost every editor save. So that no sentence can say «pus la coadă» when nothing was, every emailing press's `Feedback.toast` sentence that announced its email — «pus la coadă», «pleacă acum», «primește un email» — now says the act alone — «Înscrierea a fost anulată.», «Loc dat.», «Rol dat.», «Retrimis.», «Comanda a fost marcată plătită.», «Salvat; participanții sunt anunțați.» — and the mail line is the one place that says email. A bulk send that may reach nobody keeps its count as the act's («Mulțumiri pentru 0 participanți.», «Declarația retrimisă: 0 persoane.»), so a zero says zero; a volunteer with no address still reads «spune-i tu».
- **The roles' note says the rule as it stands.** Under a held roles email the toast adds «Dacă până atunci rolurile nu mai sunt aceleași, emailul se retrage.» — the withdrawal `render.ts` makes at the send (§837) — and not the design's «pleacă un singur email»: roles changed and changed back within the hold send two identical emails (Critic correction 6). Withdrawing a roles email whenever a newer one exists would make the promise true; it changes when an email leaves and amends §837's criterion, so it waits for the slice of rule changes.
- **Zitadel's own email.** Zitadel sends the password link itself, outside the club's queue: when an invitation to the team reached it, the toast adds «Zitadel trimite separat, acum, linkul pentru parolă.» When it did not — refused, no account, no key — the club's own invitation still left, and an info toast says «Contul Zitadel nu e gata: vezi mesajul de sus.» with what left and when (`invitedProviderFailed`, `reinvitedProviderFailed`, `membersInvitedProviderFailed`): never a green tick (§171, §288), and no toast at all when nothing was queued — the banner says why, as before.
- **What travels in the cookie.** The flash carries tokens, counts and instants — an email's type by its name in the code, how many, a departure word, the hours, the press's moment — never a name, an address or anything typed (§384's rule, amended from «only numbers»); the browser builds the sentence (`shared/feedback/mail-line.ts`) and checks every value first: a value the browser rewrote is no line. The type's words come with the backoffice's islands (`Admin.emails.types`, two kilobytes on pages only staff open). The dialog before the press (slice 3) is what names the person.
- **Short enough to read.** With the act's sentence the toast keeps to 200 characters (BR-REQ-060-01, Critic correction 9): past it the line gives up, in this order, other people's emails, the test addresses, the roles' note, the road, the club's count and Zitadel's note — what «Emailuri azi» lists anyway — and keeps what the person got and when. A toast with a mail line stays eight seconds, as the translate press's does.
- **The presses that toasted themselves.** «Trimite un mesaj participanților» flashes through `flashOutcome` now (its three sentences one, the split said by the line); an import over an event toasts only when its save emailed somebody; «Retrage și șterge invitațiile» on a person's page, which toasted nothing, says so and what its freed places sent. `tests/unit/shared/emailing-presses.test.ts` holds every emailing press to `flashOutcome` or `withPressMail`, never the bare `flash`.

**Slice 2: left for the next slices, and why.** Publishing, the deadlines' save and the editor save's job-sent emails (the alert to subscribers, «Anunță-mă», reminders and offers a moved window or a raised capacity sends at the next pass — Critic corrections 1 and 2) queue nothing in the press itself: they open no scope, and their «at the next pass of the job» lines go with slice 3's dialog lines, which read the same audiences. The design's «Ai debifat „Trimite emailul”» sentence is slice 4's opt-out.
changelogLine: - **«Emailuri azi», and what every press emailed** — every staff press that can send an email now stamps its rows with what was pressed, by whom and one id per press; «Setări» → «Emailuri» → «Emailuri azi» lists the day's emails with the names, what waits and what left, by press, and who got the same email twice — for the Administrator and the Superadministrator; and the toast after each such press says what left, to how many — the person, the club, other people — and when: now, at the estimated hour, or after Mailgun resumes. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a staff press that queues email, when its rows are committed, then every one of them — the person's message, the club's copies of it, a bulk send's one copy, an offer to the next in line — carries the press's cause, one press id shared by all of them and the staff member who pressed as its requester (a requester the service names wins); the two job routes and the drains after a response stamp the job's cause and their own run's id; a row a public flow queues carries none; and the stamp never changes whether or when a row leaves (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Setări» → «Emailuri» → «Emailuri azi», then it lists every email of the club's day — left since midnight on the club's clock, waiting from any day, failed or refused today — with the person's name and address, «Așteaptă acum» before «Au plecat azi», one row per press with its moment, its cause and who pressed; a club mailbox's row folds under the message it copies or its press and is never counted as a person; the same email sent to the same person twice or more today, by the canonical address, on the person's own mail only and counting only the rows that left — never one still waiting, which the sending may yet withdraw — is listed at the top, and a person's day on their lines counts the same rows; and a test registration's row is marked and left out of every count (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 23. Given a waiting row on the queue panel or «Emailuri azi», then its departure is one judgement for both: «Pleacă după ce Mailgun reia» with the hour while Mailgun is stopped and nothing carries a Mailgun-road row, or a Free plan's day is spent — under the «imediat» timing too, whose drain claims no such row; «Pleacă acum» while the «imediat» timing's drain is still sending a row queued a moment ago and never tried, on a road open to it, and for a press's own «Trimite acum»; the late mark is unchanged (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Emailuri azi», when anyone but an Administrator or a Superadministrator opens it — a desk role, the Organizer, the Tehnic role — then the page refuses on the server before it reads a row, and its links on the «Emailuri» tab, the queue panel and «Emailuri de trimis» are drawn only for the two roles (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a staff press that queued email, when its toast shows, then after the act's own sentence it says what left — each type in the words of «Emailuri» —, to how many — the people the press acted on, the club's mailboxes (a copy, the declaration's archive, «cineva a confirmat», a notice to the club's people), other people, test addresses counted apart — and when: now, at the estimated hour by the queue's own judgement (a volunteer's roles email held for the next press included, with its note), after Mailgun resumes, or over the next days for a newsletter past today's room, a send split between two moments saying both; with the road the press's dialog chose; read from the rows the press committed, so a row withdrawn in the same press is not told; a press that queued nothing says nothing about email, and the press's own toast sentence no longer says that an email was queued or when it leaves — the mail line alone does (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 23. Given a backoffice toast's cookie, then it carries numbers and, for an emailing press, an email type by its name in the code, a departure word and its instants — never a name, an address or anything typed — and the browser checks each value before it says it (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 97. Given a toast with its mail line, then the whole sentence keeps to 200 characters: the line drops other people's emails, the test addresses, the roles' note, the road, the club's count and Zitadel's note, in that order, and keeps what the person got and when (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an invitation to the team, a re-invitation or members added, when Zitadel refused, found no account or was never asked and the club's own invitation email was still queued, then an info toast says the account is not ready and what the club's email was and when — never a green tick; with nothing queued there is no toast and the banner says why; and when Zitadel invited the person, the toast names Zitadel's own password email beside the club's (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: every staff press's emails carry their press, «Emailuri azi» lists the day's emails by press, and each press's toast says what it emailed and when
